system_ask: Your browser asks for permission when you turn this on
system_on: Shown when the page isn't in front
system_on_always: Shown even when the page is in front
system_denied: Your browser blocks notifications from this site. Allow them in the site settings next to the address bar.
system_denied_short: Allow it in the site settings
system_unsupported: This browser doesn't support system notifications
system_always_hint: Also while a Persona tab is in front
system_footer: Shown only while the page is open but no Persona tab is in front (another site, a minimized window), once however many tabs are open. Once every page is closed, see “When Persona is closed” below. Click a notification to go to its conversation.
system_footer_always: Shown whenever the page is open, even while a Persona tab is in front, once however many tabs are open. Once every page is closed, see “When Persona is closed” below. Click a notification to go to its conversation.
sound_hint: Plays a sound when something needs you or finishes
sound_footer: Silent for the session you're viewing. When it plays follows "When something needs you" and "When an agent finishes". Applies to this browser only, and stays silent until you click or press a key on the page.
input_hint: Questions, plan approvals, tool permissions, a terminal waiting for input
input_footer: System notifications and alert sounds both follow these settings.
done_footer: A long task is a turn that ran {long} or more; quick answers are read where they were asked. You're told only if you haven't looked after a moment.
quiet_hint: Off: notifications come at any time
quiet_footer: During these hours you're not told when an agent finishes (the morning's Today card sums it up), and things that need you arrive without a sound. Reminders you asked the assistant for still come as usual. A chat bot's nudges about unanswered cards also wait while any of your devices is in its quiet hours. In this browser's time zone.
device_note: These settings belong to this browser. The hub keeps them per device, so your phone and other computers have their own.
webpush_off: Cards, finished turns and alerts reach this browser even when no Persona page is open.
webpush_renewing: On. Renewing the subscription with the hub’s new key…
webpush_failed: The last notification didn’t go out: {error}
webpush_denied: This browser blocks notifications for this site. Allow them in its site settings, then turn this on.
webpush_desktop_app: The desktop app notifies by itself.
webpush_dev: Available in the built app, not on the development server.
webpush_subpath: Not available while the hub is served under a sub-path.
webpush_insecure: Needs HTTPS (or this computer’s own address).
webpush_home_screen: On iPhone and iPad, add Persona to the Home Screen and open it from there.
webpush_unsupported: This browser can’t receive notifications while Persona is closed.
webpush_old_hub: The hub is too old for this. Update it in Settings › Hub.
webpush_no_worker: Persona’s service worker isn’t running in this browser. Reload the page and try again.
webpush_test_hint: Arrives in a moment, even with this page open.
webpush_test_sent: Test sent. It should appear in a moment.
webpush_footer: Off by default and kept per browser. Your choices below apply, as they do while a page is open. Notifications travel through this browser’s push service, encrypted so only this browser can read them. On a computer where Persona Link or the desktop app already notifies you, leave this off.
